Ahluwalia Contracts reported Q1FY26 revenue of ₹1,005 Cr (+9.3% YoY) and PAT of ₹51.1 Cr (+67% YoY), with EBITDA margin at 8.59% and order book of ₹16,582 Cr.

Ahluwalia Contracts' board approved the appointment of SCV & Co. LLP as statutory auditor for five years (FY26-FY30) and set the 46th AGM for 29 September 2025 with a record date of 22 September 2025.

Ahluwalia Contracts filed its FY25 annual report: unmodified audit opinion, consolidated revenue ₹4,099 Cr (+6.3%) and PAT ₹202 Cr (-46.1%), with contingent liabilities of ₹2,507 Cr (1.4x net worth) and borrowings of just ₹14 Cr.
Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd held its 46th AGM on 29-09-2025 via video conference with 68 members attending remotely.
Ahluwalia Contracts held its 46th AGM on 29 September 2025; shareholders approved all six resolutions, including the appointment of SCV & Co. LLP as statutory auditor and the FY25 dividend.

Ahluwalia Contracts reported Q2FY26 results with revenue of ₹1,177 Cr and PAT of ₹79 Cr, showing strong YoY growth.

Ahluwalia Contracts reported Q2FY26 results with revenue of ₹1,177 Cr and PAT of ₹79 Cr, maintaining FY26 revenue growth guidance of 15-20% and double-digit EBITDA margin target.
Ahluwalia Contracts secured an Rs. 888.38 Cr order from Bihar State Tourism Development Corporation Ltd for civil construction work at Ayodhya.
Promoter Bikramjit Ahluwalia reported nil share encumbrance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Bikramjit Ahluwalia, Promoter, declared 37,055,977 shares held by promoters and no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.

Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd. will hold an investor/analyst call on June 01, 2026, at 3:30 pm (IST) to discuss Q4FY26 and FY2026 results, led by Deputy Managing Director Shobhit Uppal, Director Vikas Ahluwalia, and CFO Satbeer Singh.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,322.3 Cr (+8.8% YoY), net profit ₹82.02 Cr (-1.6% YoY).
Ahluwalia Contracts' FY26 investor presentation showed gross order book of ₹29,676 Cr (excl. GST) at 31 Mar 2026, up about 33% YoY, and unexecuted book of ₹21,096 Cr, up about 40%.
Vipin Kumar Tiwari hosted Q4 FY2025-26 audited results conference call on 01-06-2026 at 3:30 PM via audio link (acilnet.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/10044085.mp3).
On June 1, 2026, Ahluwalia Contracts hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15-20% revenue growth in FY27 and reporting an order book of ₹21,096 Cr.
Ahluwalia Contracts reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹1,126 Cr (+12% YoY) but PAT of ₹10.4 Cr (-80% YoY) due to sharp rise in employee and finance costs.
Ahluwalia Contracts reported Q1FY27 results with 12% revenue growth to ₹1,126 Cr but 78% PAT decline to ₹11.4 Cr due to margin pressure from labour costs and AIIMS Jammu bill impact.
Ahluwalia Contracts filed its 47th Annual Report for FY26 on 3 September 2026: unmodified audit opinion, three key audit matters, and trade receivables plus contract assets at 44.50% of total assets.
Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Ltd held its 47th AGM on 29-09-2026 via video conference with 35 members present.
Ahluwalia Contracts secured a ₹310 Cr institutional building order from Bennett University on 14 October 2026.
Ahluwalia Contracts (India) Limited declared ₹90M dividend on 9 October 2026, credited to eligible shareholders via bank accounts as of 22 September 2026.
